dimensions.projection_edge: market ADP minus rank by projected PPR; positive = model projection is cheaper than market price
dimensions.price_edge: market ADP minus Overall rank; positive = draft discount
dimensions.ceiling_edge: market ADP minus rank by ceiling score; positive = ceiling available later than model implies
dimensions.bust_downside: 0-10 downside index from availability/reliability/sustainability/role/environment deficits plus market premium; does not mutate core model
dimensions.role_edge: market ADP minus rank by Role/Volume score; positive = role available at discount
dimensions.positional_edge: market positional ADP rank minus model positional rank; positive = positional discount

rules.deep_adp: ADP 180+ cannot become an automatic BUY solely from rank gap; route to DEEP STASH
rules.qb: 12-team 1-QB late-QB guardrail converts large QB discounts to CONDITIONAL BUY/VALUE WATCH
rules.rank: edge screen is companion-only and cannot mutate Overall or True Value
rules.price_coverage: uses directly resolvable ADP from market2026.json; missing prices remain explicit PENDING
rules.composite: opportunity score blends intrinsic model strength with price/projection/ceiling/role/positional discounts and downside; it is an action-priority score, not a replacement ranking
